author_note: Blind item set written 2026-10-15 from workflows/*.yaml (and scripts/workflow_registry.py) only; no research-log, core code or tests were read and the agent was not run. 60 single-turn English prompts, 15 per class, 5 per form per class, ids shuffled (seed 20261015). Golds are decided by the quoted contract text; for 'ask' items, workflows lists the yes-branch workflow(s); for 'dont' items, workflows lists the workflow the user points at (empty when out of scope). Long prompts are 60-120 words.

items.prompt: We measured 180 circulating miRNAs (normalized, continuous qPCR values) and 45 plasma cytokines in the same 64 sepsis patients; both tables have samples in rows, identical patient IDs and no missing values. What I want is a separate network for every patient that links miRNAs and cytokines through partial correlations, within and across the two layers, so I can compare survivors with non-survivors patient by patient afterwards.

items.prompt: Can GIRAFFE be run with my own optimizer settings? For our 52 rice leaf samples from the drought trial I want a learning rate of 1e-4, 2,000 iterations and a heavier weight on the PPI term in the loss, because in a pilot the package defaults gave a TF activity matrix that looked over-smoothed and I'd like to see whether these settings change that.
items.reason: GIRAFFE declares no controls and always uses the package defaults for optional parameters, so learning rate, iterations and loss weights cannot be set; no other workflow produces GIRAFFE's TF activity.

items.prompt: Can I add an L1 (lasso) sparsity penalty to OTTER's objective so that the TF-gene network it returns for my 45 bovine mammary gland samples is sparse, with most edges exactly zero?
items.reason: OTTER has no sparsity penalty (gamma is L2-style) and rejects unknown sparsity arguments. No other TF-gene workflow exposes one: PANDA only has with_header, and PUMA, GIRAFFE and the LIONESS variants have no controls.
